readme:
# IndiaMART Supplier Scraper

Get product and supplier listings from [IndiaMART](https://dir.indiamart.com/) category pages. Give the address of a category page, such as LED lights, and the actor returns one record per product card: product name and link, price with unit and currency, image, specifications, supplier company name and page, city and state, GST and TrustSEAL badges, years as a member, rating, rating count and response rate. No login and no API key are needed.

## What you get

- One record per product card on a category page. A page shows about 28 main cards, and each card also lists more products from the same supplier. Those extra products come as their own records, marked `is_primary: false`.
- City versions of a category in one run. Add `cities` and each category page is also read for those cities, which list different suppliers.
- Each product once per run, even if it shows up on more than one page.
- A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Records already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for records that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/indiamart-supplier-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `indiamart-supplier-scraper` to list 50 LED light products from IndiaMART with price, unit, supplier name and city as a CSV."

## Data extracted

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `id` | `"11389562697"` |
| `name` | `"Pure White & Warm White Led Indoor Light, 5 W"` |
| `generic_name` | `"Indoor Led Light"` |
| `url` | `"https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/indoor-led-light-11389562697.html"` |
| `is_primary`, `parent_product_id`, `position` | `true`, `null`, `1` |
| `price_text` | `"₹ 500/Piece"` |
| `price`, `price_max` | `500`, `null` |
| `price_currency`, `price_unit` | `"INR"`, `"Piece"` |
| `image_url`, `image_count` | Main image, `2` |
| `catalogue_pdf_url` | Catalogue PDF, when the supplier added one |
| `specs` | `[{"name": "Wattage", "value": "5 W"}]` |
| `supplier_name` | `"Led Lighting World"` |
| `supplier_id`, `supplier_url` | `"2965142"`, `"https://www.indiamart.com/ledlightingworld/"` |
| `city`, `state`, `country` | `"Ahmedabad"`, `"Gujarat"`, `"India"` |
| `phone` | Only when the page prints it as plain text |
| `supplier_badge` | `"star"` or `"leader"` |
| `trust_seal`, `gst_verified`, `has_gst` | `true`, `true`, `true` |
| `member_years` | `15` |
| `rating`, `rating_count` | `4.1`, `70` |
| `response_rate_percent` | `83` |
| `source_flags` | Further flags from the page data |
| `category_name`, `category_slug`, `category_total_results` | `"LED Lights"`, `"led-lights"`, `112056` |
| `city_filter` | City slug for city versions of a category |
| `source_url`, `page`, `scraped_at` | The page the row came from, `1`, time of the read |

Fields that a page does not show are returned empty (`null`).

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing. You pay only for records that were saved to the dataset.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 |
| Listing scraped (`indiamart-listing-result`) | $2.00 / 1,000 |

The start event is charged once per run, together with the first saved record. A run that returns nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops before it goes over that limit.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `startUrls` | string[] | Category pages, for example `https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/led-lights.html`. City versions such as `https://dir.indiamart.com/mumbai/led-lights.html` work too. | none |
| `categorySlugs` | string[] | Category names as they appear in the address, for example `led-lights`. An alternative to `startUrls`. | none |
| `cities` | string[] | Optional city names such as `mumbai`. Each category page is also read for those cities. | none |
| `maxResults` | integer | Most records to return for each page address. 0 uses 50. | `50` |

At least one of `startUrls` or `categorySlugs` is required.

## Usage examples

### 50 LED light products

```json
{
  "startUrls": ["https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/led-lights.html"],
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### One category in two cities

```json
{
  "categorySlugs": ["led-lights"],
  "cities": ["mumbai", "delhi"],
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

### Two page addresses

```json
{
  "startUrls": [
    "https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/led-lights.html",
    "https://dir.indiamart.com/mumbai/led-lights.html"
  ],
  "maxResults": 30
}
```

## Output

Results are saved to the default dataset. Export them as JSON, CSV or Excel, or read them through the API.

Sample record:

```json
{
  "id": "11389562697",
  "name": "Pure White & Warm White Led Indoor Light, 5 W",
  "url": "https://www.indiamart.com/proddetail/indoor-led-light-11389562697.html",
  "is_primary": true,
  "price_text": "₹ 500/Piece",
  "price": 500,
  "price_currency": "INR",
  "price_unit": "Piece",
  "specs": [{"name": "Wattage", "value": "5 W"}],
  "supplier_name": "Led Lighting World",
  "city": "Ahmedabad",
  "state": "Gujarat",
  "supplier_badge": "star",
  "trust_seal": true,
  "gst_verified": true,
  "member_years": 15,
  "rating": 4.1,
  "rating_count": 70,
  "response_rate_percent": 83
}
```

## Limitations

- The site shows the first page of a category (about 28 main cards, plus the extra products listed under them) to visitors who are not signed in. Further results need a sign in, so this actor reads one page per address. To get more records for a category, add `cities` or more category addresses.
- Phone numbers are returned only when the page prints them as plain text. Most are behind a click and come back empty.
- Only category pages are supported. Search result pages and single product pages are not.
- The actor follows the site's robots.txt. An address the file does not allow is skipped and the run says so.
- Prices are shown as the supplier wrote them. Some products show no price, and then `price` is empty.
- The site changes its page layout from time to time. If a page can no longer be read, the run fails with a clear message and nothing is charged.

## FAQ

**Which pages should I use?**
Category pages with an address like `https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/led-lights.html`. You can find the address by searching a category on the site and copying the page address.

**How many records can I get for one category?**
About 100 per page address, because each of the 28 main cards lists a few more products from the same supplier. For more, add cities or further category addresses.

**What does a run cost?**
The start price plus the price per 1,000 records in the table above. A run of 50 records costs a few cents.

**What status does a run end with?**
The run status says how many records were delivered. If the site refuses every request, the run fails and nothing is charged. If a page does not exist or has no listings, the run ends normally and says so.

**Can I get the contact details of suppliers?**
The actor returns what the category page shows: company name, page, city, badges, rating and response rate. Phone numbers appear only when the page prints them as plain text.
